listen_addr.description: IP address the gotd server listens on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

listen_port.description: Port number for the gotd service (default 8443, as per IANA for 'git' over TLS).

root_path.description: Root directory under which all Git repositories are stored (e.g., /var/got).

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous client connections (set to 0 for unlimited).

anonymous_read.description: Allow unauthenticated read access to repositories (recommended: false in production).

anonymous_write.description: Allow unauthenticated push/write access (almost always should be disabled for security).

tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections (recommended for production).

tls.cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls.key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format, must be readable only by root).

ssh_host_key.description: Path to the SSH host private key file (required if using git over SSH).

rate_limit.enabled.description: Enable bandwidth rate limiting for clients (to prevent abuse).

rate_limit.bytes_per_sec.description: Rate limit in bytes per second (ignored unless rate_limit.enabled is true).

auth_backends.description: List of authentication backends to use (order matters — first match wins).

type.description: Backend type: 'file' (local passwd file), 'ldap' (LDAP directory), or 'http' (HTTP auth proxy).

description.description: Human-readable description (used only as comment in config).

path.description: Path to the passwd-style file (for 'file' auth).

uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host:port or ldaps://).

binddn.description: DN to bind as for directory searches (empty = anonymous bind).

bind_password.description: Password for bind DN (if used); leave empty for no bind.

user_filter.description: LDAP filter to locate the user entry; '%u' is replaced by the username.

endpoint.description: URL of the HTTP endpoint to delegate authentication to.

acls.description: List of access control rules (applied in order; first match grants/denies).

type.description: Rule type: 'user' (matches by username) or 'group' (matches by group name).

group.description: Group name to match (required if type='group').

paths.description: List of repository paths this rule applies to (supports globbing, e.g., /proj/*).

logging.level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, notice, warn, error.

chroot.description: Chroot directory to sandbox gotd (e.g., /chroot/gotd). Leave empty to disable chrooting.
